news.title: Adobe integrates AI agents into Firefly and Creative Cloud creative workflows
news.description: Adobe is introducing new ways to direct the Creative Agent in Firefly and Creative Cloud to handle complex creative tasks while maintaining control over the direction and outcome. Users will be able to delegate repetitive tasks, set their preferences, adjust the agent’s plan, and choose which AI models are used.

news.title: ChatGPT Images 2.6 turns product photos into animated GIFs
news.description: OpenAI has added GIF creation to ChatGPT with its Images 2.6 model, using either a prompt or an uploaded photo. The feature can, among other things, animate an element in a product photo, but it is not yet available to all accounts.

news.title: OpenAI invites brands to create verified profiles in ChatGPT
news.description: OpenAI has invited brands to claim free verified profiles in ChatGPT, track how often they are mentioned, and set up AI agents for shoppers.

news.title: Adobe prepares local MCP integrations to edit native files
news.description: Adobe has unveiled local MCP integrations that connect third-party agents to Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere, and After Effects to directly edit native project files while keeping them editable. These integrations will be offered in a private beta in early 2027.

news.title: Dermatologist recommends skipping face washing
news.description: A dermatologist says your skin might thank you for not washing your face.

news.title: Ring launches a home security drone and patrol robot
news.description: Ring has launched Ring Robotics with the Ring Drone Cam, a $270 indoor flying camera, and the Ring Rover Cam, a $1,000 patrol robot designed for businesses. The drone can travel to the source of an alarm, and the robot can follow predefined routes, but the cameras raise privacy concerns.

news.title: Agility goes public as the first publicly traded humanoid company
news.description: Agility debuted on the Nasdaq as the first publicly traded company specializing in humanoid robots, with a $2.5 billion pre-money valuation. However, it generated just $1.8 million in revenue last year.

news.title: Business Insider reveals its 2026 Wall Street Rising Stars
news.description: Business Insider has unveiled its 2026 selection of Wall Street Rising Stars, highlighting the people shaping the future of finance.

news.title: Goldman Sachs names 109 new partners
news.description: Goldman Sachs has named 109 new partners, its largest class since 2010.

news.title: Skydance reshuffles power after its merger with Paramount-WBD
news.description: Business Insider examines Skydance’s new leadership and the power shifts following its merger with Paramount-WBD.

news.title: China-based executives gain power at TikTok
news.description: Business Insider examines how China-based executives have gained power at TikTok Shop.

news.title: Disney employees question leaders about layoffs
news.description: At Disney, employees pressed their leaders about potential layoffs as uncertainty weighed on team morale.

news.title: US air travel disruptions continue after nationwide ground stop
news.description: Thousands of flights were canceled Saturday after Friday night’s ground stop, and further disruptions are expected. Authorities blame an FAA contractor, while the Transportation Secretary is calling for $50 billion to modernize the systems.

news.title: Jensen Huang’s downfall puts Nvidia to the test
news.description: Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s former CEO and a central figure at the company, is facing revelations about relationships with female employees, while the company investigates a possible foreign intelligence operation. Nvidia’s market capitalization fell by $573 billion in one week, renewing questions about succession and key-person risk.

news.title: Deloitte eliminates GLP-1 coverage for weight loss
news.description: Deloitte will stop covering GLP-1 drugs used for weight loss for its US employees, while continuing to cover those needed for diabetes. The firm is also increasing health insurance premiums because of rising costs.

news.title: Contractors accuse Handshake AI of owing them more than $60,000
news.description: Nearly two dozen current and former contractors say AI-training startup Handshake underpaid them. Joel Thomas, in particular, says the company owes him $11,000 in unpaid wages.

news.title: RVs benefit from the data center boom
news.description: Workers traveling for well-paid data center jobs are using their per diem to rent an RV instead of a hotel. The trend is giving the RV industry a boost and filling campgrounds with long-term workers.

news.title: Students flock to career fairs to land jobs
news.description: With 42.5% of recent graduates underemployed, career fairs have become especially important and crowded. Students describe competing for internships and the benefits they gain from them.

news.title: Americans are moving less, complicating competition between regions
news.description: US regions are competing for an increasingly limited number of young people as residents move less than they used to.
